amanda (AE): Hey team — Saffron (enterprise) wants to push a POC next week. They need a legal-specialized 30B variant with 4-bit quant, prefix KV caching, and customer KMS. They also want a 95thpct latency SLO < 350ms for short prompts. Can we onboard this model variant to the catalog in time, and what are the main blockers (pricing, infra, sec)?

ben (Sales Eng): +1 on urgency. They asked about per-request pricing given quantization and KV enabled — they expect under $0.010/req. Is that realistic? Also they need dedicated capacity because of data controls.

jordan (Platform): Quick take — we can host a quantized 30B variant using our q4_0 profile but need a quick compatibility check for attention kernels and KV cache memory pattern. Primary blockers: (1) model weights format (hf vs ggml), (2) quantization artifacts for legal prompts — might need QA evals, (3) autoscaler tuning for small-request latency SLO. ETA for basic catalog entry: 3 business days if model artifacts are ready.

priya (Security): Regarding KMS + data controls: Private deployment or Dedicated with VPC + CMK is required for their compliance. We'll need to complete the security questionnaire (SOC2/ISO fields) and run a quick SCA for any native libs in the model package. Also ask legal if they require FIPS-certified HSM.

amanda (AE): They provided a model bundle link: https://saffron.example.com/models/legal-30b-v1.tar.gz — noted formats: ggml and a PyTorch .pt. They said they already quantized locally to 4-bit. Would that help?

sam (Solutions Eng): That helps but we prefer original fp16 weights for our quant pipeline to avoid double-quant artifacts. If they only supply ggml-4bit, we should schedule an eval to check hallucination/regression on our legal prompt set. I can run a quick eval series (50 prompts) — ask: do we have a shared eval set for legal?

ben (Sales Eng): On pricing: if we use q4_0 + KV caching and dedicated pool, ballpark cost per short request (200 tokens) is ~$0.007–0.012 depending on batching and prefix reuse. If we enforce strict <350ms SLO, that pushes cost up due to reserved capacity. Need ops to confirm exact committed seat pricing.

jordan (Platform): To add — autoscaler can maintain the latency SLO with min replica count and prewarmed instances. Estimate: 2x the baseline gGPU footprint for peak concurrency. Ops checklist: allocate dedicated pool, enable KV cache, set quant profile to q4_0, run compatibility test. I can spin up a scaffold with docker-compose for the model if you give me artifact access.

priya (Security): Also require a data flow diagram and confirmation whether logs/traces include PII. If so, we need retention controls. I'll attach the checklist in thread: Qs: (a) CMK required? (b) Do they want audit logs exported to their SIEM?

amanda (AE): They answered: yes CMK, yes SIEM (Splunk), retention 90 days. Also want a contractual latency SLA and a detailed runbook for failover.

sam (Solutions Eng): Action items I can take: 1) Run 50-prompt eval against our legal testset (need artifacts or their ggml+pt). 2) Bench q4_0 latency w/ KV enabled on a gGPU instance and share perf numbers. 3) Draft a minimal runbook for failover to a smaller compatible variant if we hit capacity. ETA for bench + eval: 48 hours if I get access.

jordan (Platform): I'll provision a staging pool and a dedicated route with prewarm. Need IAM creds for artifact fetch and KMS key alias.

priya (Security): I'll start the questionnaire & SCA. Sam, mark any native libs; if the bundle includes openblas/mkl or custom CUDA kernels we need binary review.

deploy-bot: Ticket created: SFF-POC-4921 "Saffron legal-30B variant onboarding - staging infra + eval" assigned to sam, jordan, priya. ETA 2024-05-09.

amanda (AE): Perfect. Ben — I told the customer we can start infra and eval now; pricing estimate pending final perf numbers. I'll note the SLA negotiation point.

ben (Sales Eng): I'll prepare a pricing slide with two options: (A) Dedicated reserved commit with SLA (higher commit, lower per-req) (B) Host on Redwood Dedicated burst (no strict SLA, lower commit). Will sync with finance for margin calc.

sam (Solutions Eng): One quick config snippet I'm going to test — posting so infra can mirror: ```yaml
model: saffron-legal-30b
variant: q4_0
kv_cache: enabled
min_replicas: 2
prewarm: true
kms: "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/saffron-cmk"
```

jordan (Platform): Got it. I'll use that for provisioning. Can everyone confirm final access list for artifact + KMS?

amanda (AE): Access list: sam@redwood, jordan@redwood, priya@redwood. I'll request Saffron to add those and share S3 link with read-only.

priya (Security): Confirmed. I'll also ask for an architecture diagram before we sign any SLA.

ben (Sales Eng): Thanks — I'll hold the pricing call until perf numbers arrive.

amanda (AE): Great, thanks team. Follow-ups: sam to post eval results here; jordan to confirm infra provision; priya to post security questionnaire link.

sam (Solutions Eng): Will do.
